x: Bob finished only 87 seconds behind K.Easlea (Enfield), clocking 54:35 over a seven mile course. Jack's effort over 5½ miles at Bexley was against even tougher opposition.
On the same day Bob Barnes appeared for his local Cambridge and Coleridge club, when he finished second to Enfield's Ken Easlea in 80:39 over a 10 miles course at Eastcote.
Wilf Wesch held off a slightly suspect Ken Easlea for a very strong win with Doug Fotheringham whipping round the hills to take the Handicap.
Another winner was Barry Ingarfield in the Enfield 10 Kilos his 48.50 brought him in ahead of veteran Ken Easlea. Ray Middleton should have won but went off course.
Due to a rather dusty track Carl Lawton was unable to produce his performance of the previous evening but did finish 2nd to Roger Mills and just held off Ken Easlea's dust storm.
